prompt: openbrain recall reminder: this session may have relevant stored
context. For substantial tasks, unfamiliar projects, or questions
about prior work, call search_brain before making implementation
decisions. Use narrower openbrain search tools when the target
person, project, or document type is clear.
openbrain context check: if this user request depends on previous
decisions, project-specific conventions, people, documents, or
unfamiliar local history, search openbrain before acting. Skip recall
for small mechanical edits or tasks whose required context is fully
available in the current conversation and repository.
openbrain pre-compact reminder: context is about to be compressed.
Silently review the session and call capture_thought for any durable
facts not yet saved to openbrain: decisions and reasons, non-obvious
fixes, stable project constraints, user preferences, milestones, or
named follow-ups. Prefer one concise, self-contained capture per
item with tags/projects/people metadata when clear. Do not capture
raw transcripts, routine progress, or unvalidated guesses.
openbrain session-end reminder: the session is ending. Silently
review the completed work and call capture_thought for durable facts
likely to matter later: decisions and reasons, non-obvious fixes,
stable project constraints, user preferences, milestones, or named
follow-ups. Do not capture raw transcripts, command output, routine
progress, obvious duplicates, or unvalidated guesses. Prefer one
concise, self-contained capture per durable item, with tags/projects/
people metadata when clear. Do not address the user unless capture
fails in a way they need to know about.
